αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’revered one’ (ὦ γύναι αἰδοίη)
αἰπόλια: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. nom./acc. pl.
αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος · also with other neut. nouns (αἰπὺ πτολίεθρον ’steep citadel’)
αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό: fem. nom. pl. demonstrative ’they’ (ἔνθ’ αἵ γ’ ’there they’)
δίου: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. gen. sg.
δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. acc. sg., epithet of heroes
εἰαρινῇ: εἰαρινός — of spring; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἐαρινῇ), with ὥρῃ: ’in spring-time’
εἰσαναβᾶσα: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (aor. εἰσανέβην): ’having gone up’
εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.): ’I had’ · also + inf., ’I was able’ (οὐδέ πῃ εἶχον στηρίξαι ’nor could I in any way brace myself’)
εὐβοίης: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. gen. sg. (Ionic η), gen. of comparison after a comparative
εὐρύαλος: Εὐρύαλος — Euryalus, a Phaeacian noble; masc. nom. sg.
εὐρύχορον: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-places, spacious; adj., fem. acc. sg. (Ἤλιδ’ ἐς εὐρύχορον ’to spacious Elis’)
ζείδωρος: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
ζώνην: ζώνη — belt, girdle; fem. acc. sg.
θρέψε: τρέφω — nourish, rear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθρεψε)
κίον: κίω — go, move; epic impf. 3 pl. (= ἐπορεύοντο), unaugmented · also κίων — pillar, column; masc. acc. sg., elided (κίον’ = κίονα): ’pillar’ (κίον’ ἀν’ ὑψηλήν ’up the tall pillar’)
κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg. · also periphrasis for the person: ’such a man’ (τοίην κεφαλήν, of Ajax)
κόλπον: κόλπος — fold, bosom (of a garment, or of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
λάθρῃ: λάθρῃ — secretly, by stealth; adv. (dat. sg. used adverbially)
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
μεμαῶτες: μέμονα — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (μεμαώς, μεμαῶτ-), with present sense: ’eager’
μεταπρέπει: μεταπρέπω — stand out among, be conspicuous among; pres. 3 sg., + dat.
μοῦσαι: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of song; fem. nom. pl.
μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall tell’ · also 1 sg. with ἄν, ’I could (not) tell’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι οὐδ’ ὀνομήνω, perhaps a short-vowel subjunctive)
νέες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νέες (= Attic νῆες)
ναῖον: νάω (ναίω) — flow, be awash, swim (a different verb from ναίω ’dwell’; traditional sense, fits the context); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔναιον), + dat. of what fills: ’swam with’
νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’standing alone’ (ὅ τε φαίνεται οἶον ’which appears alone’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: ’alone, by itself’ (σάκος οἶον ’a shield alone’)
πίονι: πίων — fat, rich, fertile; masc./neut. dat. sg., with δήμῳ
παρελέξατο: παραλέγομαι — lie beside, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic
παρθένος: παρθένος — maiden, unmarried girl; fem. nom. sg.
πεδίῳ: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. dat. sg.
πλατέ: πλατύς — broad, wide; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πλατέ’ = πλατέα)
πνείοντες: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., agreeing with οὖροι: ’blowing’ · also pres. part. masc. nom. pl. of persons, with an object: ’breathing (strength)’ (μένος πνείοντες)
πολλοῖσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
προγενέστερος: προγενής — born before, elder; adj., comparative προγενέστερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’older’
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); acc. pl.
σταθμὸν: σταθμός — door-post; masc. acc. sg. · also σταθμός — steading, farmstead; masc. acc. sg., object: ’the steading’ (σταθμὸν ῥύατ’ ’guarded the steading’)
στῆσε: ἵστημι — set up, station, moor; aor. act. 3 sg., transitive (contrast intransitive ἕστασαν)
τέκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔτεκεν)
ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg. (θείειν ταχύς ’swift to run’)
τινες: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. nom. pl. (after a relative, οἵ τινες = ὅστις pl.): ’whoever’ · also indefinite ’any’ after a negative: οὔ τινες ’not any, none’
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τόσος: τόσος — so great, so big; masc. nom. sg.
τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; epic τόσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’so many’ (correlative with ὅσσοι)
φωνὴ: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. nom. sg.
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ as subject
χαλκίδα: Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a coastal place; fem. acc. sg.
ἀμφιέποντες: ἀμφιέπω — be busy about, attend to, ply; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’busying ourselves (with)’
ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
ἄγγεα: ἄγγος — vessel, pail; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄγγη)
ἄγεν: ἄγω — lead, take; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἦγεν): ’took, brought’
ἄλσος: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. acc. sg.
ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
ἐγχείῃ: ἐγχέω — pour in; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic lengthened (= ἐγχέῃ): ’may pour’
ἐκέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’excelled’
ἐνιαυτῶν: ἐνιαυτός — year, cycle of the seasons; gen. pl.
ἐπίστροφος: ἐπίστροφος — much-visiting, going about among (+ gen.); nom. sg.
ἐρεχθῆος: Ἐρεχθεύς — Erechtheus, early king of Athens; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον, epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πτολίεθρον: ’well-built (citadel)’
ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
ἑρμιόνην: Ἑρμιόνη — Hermione, daughter of Menelaus and Helen; fem. acc. sg.
ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with θυμῷ: ’in his own (heart)’
ἔναιον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl.: ‘they dwelt’ · also impf. 1 sg. (the same form serves both persons): ’I dwelt’
ἔξοχος: ἔξοχος — standing out, pre-eminent (+ partitive gen.); adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
ἔριζεν: ἐρίζω — contend, vie, rival; impf. 3 sg.
ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
ἡγεμόνευ: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, lead; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεμόνευ’ = ἡγεμόνευε)
ἡγεμόνευε: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be the guide (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. (augment not visible on ἡ-) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead the way!’
ἡγεμόνευεν: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, guide; impf. 3 sg.
ἡγεῖτο: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’led’
ἰδ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj., elided (ἰδ’ = ἰδέ)
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); masc. nom. sg.
ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ἱερὸν μένος ’sacred might’
ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.: ’looking like (him)’
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ἵσταντο: ἵστημι — set, place; mid. impf. 3 pl. (with ἀνά in tmesis): ’stood up, rose’ · also plain mid. impf. 3 pl., with adv. ἀμφί: ’stood around, took their places’
ἵστασαν: ἵστημι — set, station; here transitive, moor (a ship); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were mooring’ · also transitive, of setting up a vessel: ’they set up (a tripod)’
ὀνομήνω: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; fut./aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I shall name’
ὁμοῖος: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. sg., + dat.
ὑπερώϊον: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. acc. sg., epic ὑπερώϊον (= Attic ὑπερῷον)
